prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Ribbon by the Pot; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: Classroom craft corner with one window table and one low shelf. Two clearly different plant pots remain visible from the main table: tall blue pot at window, small yellow pot on shelf.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One brown-paper parcel without ribbon; One long red ribbon; One tall blue plant pot on the window table; One small yellow plant pot on the low shelf; One craft table
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Red ribbon lies beside yellow shelf pot; parcel has no tie yet.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Kit holds the brown paper closed around a small rectangular parcel. Zoe points broadly across the room, where both pots can be seen. Continuity: Red ribbon lies beside yellow shelf pot; parcel has no tie yet.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Design board consistency: clean flat 2D and human child/adult body proportions, correct normal furniture geometry, no impossible perspective or room-sized shelf. All ordinary physical props clean unlettered designs. Reference board is production design only; not final page panels.
Location geometry: tall blue plant pot and separate small watering can on LEFT window table; small yellow plant pot and one long loose red ribbon on RIGHT low shelf. Main craft table front. Brown parcel only, ribbon initially off parcel. Include two-loop red tied bow design separately only as design reference, never a second ribbon in setting. Pots clearly distinct sizes/colors. Stable saucer under blue pot; normal manageable child-sized table.

visualReview.note: Direct native and installed WebP reference: blue tall pot/saucer at left window, yellow small pot and single loose ribbon at right shelf; untied parcel; coherent child-scale furniture.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
